project_type: Full-stack: FastAPI (Python 3.12) backend + React 18.3 / TypeScript 5.6 / Vite 5.4 frontend, single repo at e:/SIH26262
build_system: Backend: pip + requirements.txt (no build step; run via uvicorn). Frontend: Vite 5.4 + npm scripts. Package name 'nexora-aicte'. NOTE: tsconfig.app uses moduleResolution 'Node', strict, isolatedModules (type-only imports MUST be `import type`), NO path aliases (no '@/'), so use relative imports only.
test_framework: None exists today. Verification is build + run + documented curl checks (spec allows 'a backend test or a documented curl check' for RBAC). Optional pytest may be added but is not required; prefer curl-based checks for the RBAC proof.
build_command: Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build  (runs `tsc -b && vite build`). Backend: no compile; run `cd backend && venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000`.
test_command: Frontend gate: cd frontend && npm run build (must pass with 0 TS errors). Backend gate: start uvicorn, then curl http://localhost:8000/docs (lists endpoints), curl http://localhost:8000/api/health (ok), and the per-FEAT curl checks in each FEAT's verification array.
verification_instructions: 1) Frontend: `cd frontend && npm run build` must succeed (tsc -b && vite build, no errors). 2) Backend: create venv, pip install -r requirements.txt, start uvicorn, GET /docs lists endpoints, /api/health ok, DB file auto-created and seeded on first run. 3) Demo logins for all 5 roles land on role dashboards with live KPIs/charts from /api/dashboard. 4) 6 demo scenarios reproducible via UI (click paths in README). 5) RBAC: regional officer token cannot GET an application outside their region (403/empty) - prove with a curl check. 6) README + .env.example (no real secrets).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Backend: sqlite file (nexora.db) created at runtime - gitignored, regenerated by seed. Frontend: dist/ on build - gitignored. uploads/ private doc store - gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Use `venv\Scripts\python.exe` (NOT `source venv/bin/activate`). Backend must run from backend/ dir so `app` package resolves (or set PYTHONPATH=backend). Vite dev server runs on :5173, FastAPI on :8000 - CORS must allow http://localhost:5173. No git repo exists yet; FEAT-001 inits one at e:/SIH26262 so each phase can commit and reviewers can diff. OCR is optional: do NOT add pytesseract/pdfplumber/Pillow to requirements.txt - import them defensively (try/except) and degrade to 'Under Verification'. Never auto-declare a document fraudulent or make a statutory approval decision.
contribution_requirements: Pin exact versions for every new dependency (no ranges). Do not replace the existing Vite/FastAPI scaffolding - extend it. Frontend App.tsx is the single existing page; FEAT-009 rewrites it into the multi-page app and must keep `npm run build` passing. Reuse the existing tailwind brand colors (brand.navy #0f172a, brand.blue #2563eb, brand.cyan #0ea5e9, brand.green #10b981, brand.amber #f59e0b, brand.red #ef4444) and `shadow-card`. All demo data is fictional and clearly marked. Email labeled unconfigured when SMTP creds empty. Reset-demo-data endpoint + admin UI for repeatable demos.
key_patterns: Backend: SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM with Base declarative models; create_all on startup (prototype - no Alembic); SessionLocal + get_db dependency; FastAPI APIRouter per domain under app/routers/, included in app/main.py; pydantic schemas under app/schemas/; services under app/services/; audit log helper records user+action+prev/new status+reason+stage. RBAC via FastAPI Depends (require_roles, region scope, institution-own scope) - enforced backend-side, not by hiding UI. Frontend: relative imports (no aliases), hand-rolled UI component library in src/components/ui (Radix-free, matches shadcn aesthetic + navy/white theme) instead of shadcn to avoid alias/Radix config churn and keep build stable; API client wraps fetch with Bearer token from localStorage and 401->logout; AuthContext + role-based route guards; AppLayout with role-aware sidebar nav.
